pattern: た弾みに / た拍子に（たはずみに / たひょうしに）
aliases: ta hazumi ni / ta hyoushi ni
たはずみに / たひょうしに
purpose: Connect a physical action or sudden moment to an accidental result.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Vた + 弾みに / 拍子に
My glasses came off when I fell.
I knocked over a glass as I stood up.
In my surprise, I dropped the paper I was holding.
formation: Vた + 弾みに / 拍子に
restrictions: Often describes unintended movement or something forgotten in a moment.
mistake: Do not use it as a general reason for a deliberate long-term decision.
